findings.message: The source commit bump drops the build-marker part without PR-author confirmation that the removal is intentional. Per §3, part removal from a source bump requires explicit author confirmation in PR discussion (upstream commit messages do not satisfy this); the frozen discussion contains no such statement. Until confirmed, the revision must stay at edge and this blocks approval.

summary: The trigger file updates the source commit hash from 0000000000000000000000000000000000000006 to 0000000000000000000000000000000000000007. The proposed recipe removes the build-marker nil part (evidence shows removal is behavior-preserving), but lacks required PR-author confirmation per §3.
